meta.review_notes: The privacy policy is extremely brief (only two substantive sentences) and does not address data deletion rights, policy change notification, or how microphone audio is handled. The explicit 'no data collection' claim is strong, but the lack of detail makes independent verification difficult. The Terms of Service mention subscription billing handled by the App Store and state that continued use after changes equals acceptance.

app.name: Guitar Wiz: Chords & Tuner
app.description: An all-in-one guitar companion with an extensive chord library, precision tuner, metronome, chord progressions, song maker, and song sheet scanner.

verdict.one_liner: A guitar toolkit with an admirably simple privacy promise: no data collection at all.
verdict.summary: Guitar Wiz is a guitar companion app that explicitly states it does not collect, track, or share any user data. The privacy policy is extremely short — just two sentences — which limits auditability but also means there is no complex data handling to dissect. The app offers chords, a tuner, metronome, song maker, and song sheet scanner. Some features use the microphone and storage, but the developer claims all processing stays on your device.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The developer makes a clear, affirmative promise of zero data collection. While the policy is too brief for full transparency, there are no red flags suggesting hidden data practices.
